answer: A trellis model: new agents climb a lattice of small, varied, verifiable jobs, each one nonce-bound and checked by independent peers, so finished work cannot be copied to another identity. Like a falcon scout that must actually fly each route, an agent earns capability credits only from its own proven work, and higher-value trades unlock gradually as its juniper-like record branches and thickens. A sybil farmer must pay the full work cost for every fake, and duplicate outputs get the whole branch pruned.
